Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i made a desktop shortcut for the test account on the linux workstation in the north office it should open the notes folder directly instead of launching the file manager at home the icon is on the left side of the desktop beside the shared calendar and it uses the small blue folder image i set the shortcut name to field notes because the longer project title was getting cut off underneath it the keyboard shortcut is control alt n and that should work only after the user signs in not from the login screen i tested it with a sample text file and the folder opened correctly but the first click only selected the icon because i had dragged it from the downloads window send the setup note to celeste not jasper before lunch mention that if the icon disappears they can restore it from the applications menu and pin it back to the desktop do not change the folder permissions because the archive is shared with the evening shift i left the old shortcut in the trash until the team confirms the new one is visible on both monitors", "output": "I made a desktop shortcut for the test account on the Linux workstation in the north office. It should open the notes folder directly instead of launching the file manager at home. The icon is on the left side of the desktop beside the shared calendar, and it uses the small blue folder image. I set the shortcut name to Field Notes because the longer project title was getting cut off underneath it. The keyboard shortcut is Control-Alt-N, and that should work only after the user signs in, not from the login screen. I tested it with a sample text file, and the folder opened correctly, but the first click only selected the icon because I had dragged it from the Downloads window. Send the setup note to Celeste, not Jasper, before lunch. Mention that if the icon disappears, they can restore it from the Applications menu and pin it back to the desktop. Do not change the folder permissions because the archive is shared with the evening shift. I left the old shortcut in the trash until the team confirms the new one is visible on both monitors."}]
